source.detail: lockstep major bump; per-doc diff verified additive/doc-only

spec_evidence.checked: GitHub commit patch for discovery/workspaceevents-v1.json fetched and read line by line. Patch adds two new OAuth scopes (chat.users.availability, chat.users.availability.readonly) to the scope lists of existing methods and bumps revision. Additive scope grants; no method, parameter, or schema change.

fix.migration_guide: All ten google entries in this release cite the same generator PR #3920 (commit 08443b4). The 'BREAKING CHANGES' banner comes from release-please propagating a breaking marker from other packages in the monorepo commit (aiplatform et al.) into every lockstep major bump; this package's own discovery diff was verified line by line from the GitHub commit patch and contains no removal, rename, retype, or new required field. Patch adds two new OAuth scopes (chat.users.availability, chat.users.availability.readonly) to the scope lists of existing methods and bumps revision. Additive scope grants; no method, parameter, or schema change. No consumer code change is required; the major version number alone is not a breaking API surface change for this package.
